effect.fr: Tenu: Change Silvallié dans sa forme Poison.  Change le type de Coup Varia-Type en Poison.
effect.en: Held: Changes Silvally to its Poison form.  Changes Multi-Attack’s type to Poison.

flavor.ko: 독타입의 데이터가 들어 있는 메모리. 특정 포켓몬이 지니면 타입이 바뀐다.
flavor.en: A memory disc that contains Poison-type data. It changes the type of the holder if held by a certain species of Pokémon.
